newsitem.title: UK: Kenwood shares advance on takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Kenwood shares advance on takeover talk.

text.p: Shares in household appliances group Kenwood Appliances Plc opened sharply higher on Monday following a Financial Times report that Pifco Holdings Plc was poised to make a bid for the company.
Kenwood shares were 16p higher at 236-1/2p by 0832 GMT in active early trade whilst Pifco shares were unchanged.

The Financial Times (FT) newspaper said that Pifco, which has a market capitalisation about half that of Kenwood, had set its sights on Kenwood to be able to compete more effectively in the European appliances market.
Pifco chairman Michael Webber told the FT that there was "sound commerical and industrial logic for putting the two companies together."

Kenwood confirmed that Pifco had made an "informal" approach but added that no formal bid had been made. The newspaper said Pifco was unlikely to be interested in a contested bid and added that Kenwood would advise shareholders against a paper offer.
